name: Sun Retreats Estero Bay
note: All-ages Sun Outdoors RV resort on US-41 (S Tamiami Trl), south Fort Myers, around two ponds. Single nights bookable on Campspot (2026 quote): standard full-hookup back-in $113, deluxe concrete, paver or pond-front $121, premium pull-through $138.45; all sites take rigs to 45 ft. In peak winter Campspot showed a 28-night minimum, so expect to book single nights outside winter. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Fort Myers relaxed-price mini-sweep (AWH 2026-10-05: nightly up to $150 allowed for this area only, rate stated in the note).
